key: Something unseeable is in the way.
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
ja: 何か見えない気配が道をふさいでいる。

key: \PN used the Silvon Scope.
en: \PN used the Silvon Scope.
ja: \PNはシルボンスコープを使った。

key: The startled Pokémon attacked!
en: The startled Pokémon attacked!
ja: 驚いたポケモンがおそいかかってきた!

key: "Elizabeth Connal"
en: "Elizabeth Connal"
ja: 「エリザベス・コナル」

key: "Monty Belrose"
en: "Monty Belrose"
ja: 「モンティ・ベルローズ」

key: "Caroline Belrose"
en: "Caroline Belrose"
ja: 「キャロライン・ベルローズ」

key: "Zina Vanhanen"
en: "Zina Vanhanen"
ja: 「ジーナ・ヴァンハネン」

key: "Kiki Mikael Argall"
en: "Kiki Mikael Argall"
ja: 「キキ・ミカエル・アルガル」

key: "Tara--"
en: "Tara--"

key: "Tara Copperman"
en: "Tara Copperman"
ja: 「タラ・コッパーマン」

key: SIMON: We meet again, \PN.
en: SIMON: We meet again, \PN.
ja: サイモン：また会ったな、\PN。

key: Why have you come to a place like this? I'm sure you're not here to mourn.
en: Why have you come to a place like this? I'm sure you're not here to mourn.
ja: なぜこんな場所に来た? 弔いに来たわけじゃないだろう。

key: But I am.
en: But I am.
ja: だが、私はそのために来た。

key: I've spent far too many hours here already.
en: I've spent far too many hours here already.
ja: もう、あまりにも長い時間をここで過ごしてしまった。

key: And now I've lost again.
en: And now I've lost again.
ja: そして今、また失ってしまった。

key: Look.
en: Look.
ja: 見てくれ。

key: SIMON: Not that I could get her body out of the lake, but I figured she at least deserved a memory.
en: SIMON: Not that I could get her body out of the lake, but I figured she at least deserved a memory.
ja: サイモン：湖から彼女の遺体を引き上げることはできなかったが、せめて彼女をしのぶものくらいはあってしかるべきだと思ってな。

key: I couldn't even find out her last name.
en: I couldn't even find out her last name.
ja: 彼女の苗字すら、突き止められなかった。

key: I don't know if she had any family, or friends...
en: I don't know if she had any family, or friends...
ja: 家族や友人がいたのかどうかすら、わからない……

key: All of that rests at the bottom of the lake now.
en: All of that rests at the bottom of the lake now.
ja: そのすべてが、今は湖の底に沈んでいる。

key: SIMON: I swore that I would get revenge on that woman.
en: SIMON: I swore that I would get revenge on that woman.
ja: サイモン：私はあの女にふくしゅうすると誓った。

key: But what good is another death?
en: But what good is another death?
ja: だが、もう一つ死を重ねたところで何になる?

key: Someone, somewhere, must feel the same about that woman as I did for Tara... and Lyssa.
en: Someone, somewhere, must feel the same about that woman as I did for Tara... and Lyssa.
ja: どこかの誰かが、あの女に対して、私がタラや……リッサに抱いていたのと同じ思いを抱いているにちがいない。

key: Twice now.
en: Twice now.
ja: これで二度目だ。

key: Twice, I lost the girl I loved.
en: Twice, I lost the girl I loved.
ja: 二度も、愛した女性を失った。

key: When my wife died, I could think of nothing else but getting her back.
en: When my wife died, I could think of nothing else but getting her back.
ja: 妻が死んだとき、私は彼女を取り戻すことしか考えられなかった。

key: Then Commander Sirius came.
en: Then Commander Sirius came.
ja: そこへ、シリウス司令官が現れた。

key: He told me when Team Meteor recreated the world anew, that I could have my wife back.
en: He told me when Team Meteor recreated the world anew, that I could have my wife back.
ja: チームメテオが世界を新しく創り直したとき、妻を取り戻せると彼は言った。

key: I was all too happy to accept.
en: I was all too happy to accept.
ja: 私は喜んでそれを受け入れた。

key: But then I was partnered with Tara, and she was always so energetic and sincere and...
en: But then I was partnered with Tara, and she was always so energetic and sincere and...
ja: だが、私はタラと組むことになった。彼女はいつも元気で、誠実で……

key: I fell in love with her instead.
en: I fell in love with her instead.
ja: 私は代わりに、彼女に恋をしてしまった。

key: She was the light of my world.
en: She was the light of my world.
ja: 彼女は私の世界の光だった。

key: Now I'm left with darkness again.
en: Now I'm left with darkness again.
ja: 今、また私には闇だけが残された。

key: Do you think, if the world was reborn, I would see them both again?
en: Do you think, if the world was reborn, I would see them both again?
ja: 世界が生まれ変わったら、私は二人にまた会えると思うか?

key: SIMON: You're probably right.
en: SIMON: You're probably right.
ja: サイモン：おそらく、君の言う通りだろう。

key: But then what? How could I explain that to Lyssa?
en: But then what? How could I explain that to Lyssa?
ja: だが、それでどうする? リッサにどう説明すればいい?

key: Even in redemption, all that awaits me is guilt.
en: Even in redemption, all that awaits me is guilt.
ja: 救われたところで、待っているのは罪悪感だけだ。

key: SIMON: ...Of course not.
en: SIMON: ...Of course not.
ja: サイモン：……いや、そんなはずはない。

key: It was all just a pipe dream to begin with, wasn't it?
en: It was all just a pipe dream to begin with, wasn't it?
ja: 最初から、ただの絵空事だったんだろう?

key: Running away from this world was just a way to escape my guilt.
en: Running away from this world was just a way to escape my guilt.
ja: この世界から逃げることは、ただ自分の罪悪感から逃げる手段でしかなかった。

key: Guilt for losing my wife...
en: Guilt for losing my wife...
ja: 妻を失ったことへの罪悪感……

key: Guilt from not dying in Tara's place...
en: Guilt from not dying in Tara's place...
ja: タラの代わりに死ねなかったことへの罪悪感……

key: Guilt for having felt anything for Tara after I swore my life to Lyssa...
en: Guilt for having felt anything for Tara after I swore my life to Lyssa...
ja: リッサに人生を誓っておきながら、タラに想いを寄せてしまったことへの罪悪感……

key: Even if I saw them again, I couldn't bear to face them.
en: Even if I saw them again, I couldn't bear to face them.
ja: たとえ二人にまた会えたとしても、私は二人と向き合うことに耐えられないだろう。

key: I'm resigning from Team Meteor.
en: I'm resigning from Team Meteor.
ja: 私はチームメテオを辞める。

key: I've spent too long dwelling on the past already.
en: I've spent too long dwelling on the past already.
ja: 過去にとらわれすぎて、もう長い時間が経ちすぎた。

key: I can't take it anymore.
en: I can't take it anymore.
ja: もう耐えられない。

key: There's no point in trying to recreate what's already lost.
en: There's no point in trying to recreate what's already lost.
ja: 失われたものを作り直そうとしたところで、意味などない。

key: If you ever need to find me, I'll be at my home in the west Peridot Ward.
en: If you ever need to find me, I'll be at my home in the west Peridot Ward.
ja: もし私を探すことがあれば、ペリドットワードの西にある我が家にいる。

key: "Lyssa Copperman"
en: "Lyssa Copperman"
ja: 「リッサ・コッパーマン」

key: The name is too mangled to read.
en: The name is too mangled to read.
ja: 名前は損傷がひどく、読み取れない。

key: "Officer Jacob S. Crowley -Passed in recent service"
en: "Officer Jacob S. Crowley -Passed in recent service"
ja: 「巡査 ジェイコブ・S・クロウリー ――殉職」

key: VICTORIA: Oh! \PN, are you really back?
en: VICTORIA: Oh! \PN, are you really back?
ja: ヴィクトリア：あら! \PN、本当に戻ってきたのですか?

key: I've heard about a lot of things happening up in Carnelia, and I was really worried!
en: I've heard about a lot of things happening up in Carnelia, and I was really worried!
ja: カーネリアでいろいろなことが起きていると聞いて、とても心配していたのですよ!

key: But of course, you're just fine.
en: But of course, you're just fine.
ja: でも、もちろんあなたは大丈夫なのですね。

key: You always are, right?
en: You always are, right?
ja: いつもそうでしょう?

key: VICTORIA: We always are.
en: VICTORIA: We always are.
ja: ヴィクトリア：わたしたちはいつもそうです。

key: I was just saying "Hello."
en: I was just saying "Hello."
ja: ただ「こんにちは」と言っていただけです。

key: VICTORIA: \PN, you're finally back.
en: VICTORIA: \PN, you're finally back.
ja: ヴィクトリア：\PN、ようやく戻ってきたのですね。

key: VICTORIA: I was just... saying "Hello."
en: VICTORIA: I was just... saying "Hello."
ja: ヴィクトリア：ただ……「こんにちは」と言っていただけです。

key: "It's been a while."
en: "It's been a while."
ja: 「久しぶりです」

key: And...
en: And...
ja: それと……

key: "Did you find the peace you were looking for?"
en: "Did you find the peace you were looking for?"
ja: 「あなたが探していた安らぎは、見つかりましたか?」

key: VICTORIA: I think this city finally has.
en: VICTORIA: I think this city finally has.
ja: ヴィクトリア：この街は、ようやく見つけたのだと思います。

key: I wish I could say the same.
en: I wish I could say the same.
ja: 自分にも同じことが言えたらいいのですが。

key: Trying to take over the Academy has been...
en: Trying to take over the Academy has been...
ja: アカデミーを引き継ごうとするのは……

key: Well, they're not shoes I'm capable of filling.
en: Well, they're not shoes I'm capable of filling.
ja: まあ、わたしに埋められる穴ではありません。

key: It's never going to be the same without her, but then it's thanks to her sacrifice that it even still exists.
en: It's never going to be the same without her, but then it's thanks to her sacrifice that it even still exists.
ja: 彼女なしでは、もう同じではありえません。でも、それでもまだこうして存在しているのは、彼女の犠牲のおかげなのです。

key: So I've been thinking, how can the place continue to grow?
en: So I've been thinking, how can the place continue to grow?
ja: だから、この場所がどうすれば成長を続けられるか、ずっと考えてきました。

key: It turns out the answer wasn't to tear ourselves away from Reborn City like we did before, but to give ourselves to it.
en: It turns out the answer wasn't to tear ourselves away from Reborn City like we did before, but to give ourselves to it.
ja: 答えは、以前のようにリボーンシティから距離を置くことではなく、この街に自分たちをささげることだったのです。

key: Many of our students have been very involved in helping bring everything together here.
en: Many of our students have been very involved in helping bring everything together here.
ja: 生徒の多くが、この街をまとめ上げる手伝いに深く関わってくれています。

key: But, that's just the answer I found.
en: But, that's just the answer I found.
ja: でも、それはわたしが見つけた答えにすぎません。

key: If she were still here--
en: If she were still here--
ja: もし彼女がまだここにいたら――

key: Well, if she were still in charge,
en: Well, if she were still in charge,
ja: いえ、もし彼女がまだ責任者だったら、

key: I think her answer would have been different.
en: I think her answer would have been different.
ja: きっと違う答えを出していたと思います。

key: I'm sorry, I'm just going off about things like always.
en: I'm sorry, I'm just going off about things like always.
ja: ごめんなさい、いつものように話しすぎてしまいましたね。

key: So Ame is looking for me?
en: So Ame is looking for me?
ja: それで、アメがわたしを探しているのですか?

key: I wonder if she has another project for the students.
en: I wonder if she has another project for the students.
ja: 生徒たちに、また何か企画があるのかもしれませんね。

key: All right, I'll go meet her soon. Thank you for telling me.
en: All right, I'll go meet her soon. Thank you for telling me.
ja: わかりました、すぐに会いに行きます。教えてくれてありがとうございます。

key: For now, I just want another moment here.
en: For now, I just want another moment here.
ja: 今はもう少しだけ、ここにいたい気分です。

key: Um, \PN?
en: Um, \PN?
ja: あの、\PN?

key: ...Well,
en: ...Well,
ja: ……その、

key: It's good to see you again.
en: It's good to see you again.
ja: また会えてよかったです。

key: I'll go meet Ame soon.
en: I'll go meet Ame soon.
ja: すぐにアメに会いに行きますね。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
